dataset.license: Public research benchmark; source authors retain rights. Local evaluation, no raw archive redistribution; limited attributed screenshots.
dataset.source: Visual Tracker Benchmark / Yi Wu, Ming-Hsuan Yang, Jongwoo Lim; https://rvlab.snu.ac.kr/research/tracker_benchmark; original JPEGs, stride 1
dataset.title: Fresh138 skating2-1-1 original camera evidence

input.provenance: Original external OTB target boxes, MATLAB one-based XYWH converted to normalized clipped corners. Source-only AI visibility reviewed after method lock and before predictions; no independent human adjudication. Skating2 reciprocal other boxes are external annotations for the other target. Liquor other boxes are coarse source-only AI annotations on10 later sampled images only; other images lack independent distractor labels. Missing distractor labels cannot prove no switches. No tracker outputs used. Source note138 explains crossing fallback and bottle cohort addition.
input.annotator: OTB authors (target/skater boxes); Codex source-only AI (visibility/bottle others)

audit.scope: Independent target boxes and separately declared visibility score original runs. IoU failure is not automatically an identity switch. audit.scope: Independent target boxes and separately declared visibility score original runs. IoU failure is not automatically an identity switch. Distractor match requires overlap with an independently labelled other object. Missing and uncertain labels remain explicit; no physical or personal identity certification.

input.provenance: Original external OTB target boxes, MATLAB one-based XYWH converted to normalized clipped corners. Source-only AI visibility reviewed after method lock and before predictions; no independent human adjudication. Skating2 reciprocal other boxes are external annotations for the other target. Liquor other boxes are coarse source-only AI annotations on10 later sampled images only; other images lack independent distractor labels. Missing distractor labels cannot prove no switches. No tracker outputs used. Source note138 explains crossing fallback and bottle cohort addition.

audit.scope: Independent target boxes and separately declared visibility score original runs. IoU failure is not automatically an identity switch. Distractor match requires overlap with an independently labelled other object. Missing and uncertain labels remain explicit; no physical or personal identity certification.

input.provenance: Original external OTB target boxes, MATLAB one-based XYWH converted to normalized clipped corners. Source-only AI visibility reviewed after method lock and before predictions; no independent human adjudication. Skating2 reciprocal other boxes are external annotations for the other target. Liquor other boxes are coarse source-only AI annotations on10 later sampled images only; other images lack independent distractor labels. Missing distractor labels cannot prove no switches. No tracker outputs used. Source note138 explains crossing fallback and bottle cohort addition.
input.annotator: OTB authors (target/skater boxes); Codex source-only AI (visibility/bottle others)

input.provenance: Original external OTB target boxes, MATLAB one-based XYWH converted to normalized clipped corners. Source-only AI visibility reviewed after method lock and before predictions; no independent human adjudication. Skating2 reciprocal other boxes are external annotations for the other target. Liquor other boxes are coarse source-only AI annotations on10 later sampled images only; other images lack independent distractor labels. Missing distractor labels cannot prove no switches. No tracker outputs used. Source note138 explains crossing fallback and bottle cohort addition.

input.provenance: Original external OTB target boxes, MATLAB one-based XYWH converted to normalized clipped corners. Source-only AI visibility reviewed after method lock and before predictions; no independent human adjudication. Skating2 reciprocal other boxes are external annotations for the other target. Liquor other boxes are coarse source-only AI annotations on10 later sampled images only; other images lack independent distractor labels. Missing distractor labels cannot prove no switches. No tracker outputs used. Source note138 explains crossing fallback and bottle cohort addition.
